dedupe_keys.name: asuncion downloadable city map base cartography layers lots blocks streets neighbourhoods cadastral zones

description: Municipalidad de Asunción, Paraguay publishes four downloads on the city page "downloadable map": a layered map (MAPA EN CAPAS), a cadastral map, the regulatory plan map (Plan Regulador) and the tax zone map; the layered map zip, opened here, holds a base cartography folder of shapefiles for neighbourhoods (BARRIOS_ASU), streets (CALLES), lots (LOTES), blocks (MANZANAS) and cadastral zones (ZONAS_CATASTRALES), with the street, lot and block layers versioned 30 January 2026. Coverage: the city of Asunción; the layers carry a version date of 30 January 2026, and the site was read on 2026-09-29. Format and access: zipped shapefiles downloadable without registration from the municipal website. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Not stated on the pages read; cost: free. Caveats: only the layered map zip was opened and only for its file names, so attribute fields and feature counts are unconfirmed; the cadastral, regulatory plan and tax zone maps were not opened; no licence is stated on the pages read; the layers are geometry with no building footprints named. Simulation uses: parcel, block and street geometry for urban exposure, flood and land-use models in Asunción, and as a spatial base for joining planning-regime and tax-zone layers. Related catalogue records: Paraguay national open data portal (data-paraguay-national-open-data-portal); Paraguay georeferenced health establishments (data-paraguay-georeferenced-health-establishments-p04163); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
